**Session / topic:** ETS versus ARIMA

## What I did
Fitted ETS alongside the ARIMA models and compared their forecasts.

## What I learned
ETS and ARIMA overlap and neither dominates, so out-of-sample accuracy is the fair comparison.

## Difficulties and open questions
